text: In an echo state network, which of the three weight matrices W_in, W_rec, W_out are actually trained?
choices: All three matrices W_in, W_rec, and W_out are trained by backpropagation
W_in and W_rec are trained; W_out is fixed at random
W_rec and W_out are trained; W_in is fixed at random
Only the readout W_out is trained; W_in and W_rec stay at their random initialization
explanation: The defining simplification of the ESN is that only the linear readout W_out is trained (by ridge regression), while the input weights W_in and recurrent weights W_rec are drawn randomly and held fixed. The other options all wrongly train the input and/or recurrent weights.
